author: I hate crossfade playback
title: Crossfade playback is really useless
content: I used to love your app as my favorite music player app in my I phone and it should be always like that , if you not updated the "really useless crossfade playback" that made my music can not play continuously song by song as they used to be in perfect version 3.0 and turn into a nervous one.The sound-fading makes me nervous every time it comes to the end of the song, since I mix all of the songs to play continuously by myself already, without using your useless crossfade playback. If the next update there is still a crossfade playback function in your app, I'm sure to say that I will not use your app anymore.
